from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,os,signal,json
repo=Path('/Users/steventran/jobpipe');base='3c214d988f7ea7a62e32b833b952a7043df41246'
def git(*a):return subprocess.run(['git',*a],cwd=repo,capture_output=True,text=True,check=True).stdout.strip()
if git('rev-parse','HEAD')!=base:raise SystemExit('AUTHORITY_CHANGED')
code=r'''
import asyncio,json
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright
from tools.live_ats_inspect import allowed_url
from tools.ats_field_labels import extract_field_labels
from tools.ats_review_answer_matches import build_review_with_verified_matches
url="https://jobs.lever.co/ethena/f85bcfd1-8d2c-4cf5-a6ab-1c8ddab14c65/apply"
async def main():
 async with async_playwright() as pw:
  b=await pw.chromium.launch(headless=True)
  try:
   page=await b.new_page(accept_downloads=False)
   async def guard(route):
    if route.request.is_navigation_request() and not allowed_url(route.request.url):await route.abort()
    else:await route.continue_()
   await page.route("**/*",guard)
   response=await page.goto(url,wait_until="domcontentloaded",timeout=25000)
   await page.wait_for_timeout(2500)
   if not allowed_url(page.url):raise RuntimeError('UNAPPROVED_REDIRECT')
   fields=await extract_field_labels(page)
   questions=[f['question'] for f in fields if f['type']=='radio' and f.get('question')]
   if not questions:raise RuntimeError('NO_REAL_RADIO_QUESTION')
   q=questions[0]
   synthetic=[{"question":q,"answer":"SYNTHETIC_ONLY_NEVER_FILL","scope":"employer","employer":"Ethena","human_verified":True}]
   matched=build_review_with_verified_matches(fields,{"full_name","email","phone"},synthetic,"Ethena")
   wrong=build_review_with_verified_matches(fields,{"full_name","email","phone"},synthetic,"Other Employer")
   summary={"http_status":response.status if response else None,"field_count":len(fields),"review_items":matched['review_item_count'],"synthetic_verified_matches":matched['verified_answer_match_count'],"wrong_employer_matches":wrong['verified_answer_match_count'],"matched_remain_review":all(x.get('status')=='human_review' for x in matched['human_review']),"auth":"not_attempted","fill":"not_attempted","submit":"not_attempted"}
   assert 'SYNTHETIC_ONLY_NEVER_FILL' not in str(matched)
   print(json.dumps(summary,sort_keys=True))
  finally:await b.close()
asyncio.run(main())
'''
p=subprocess.Popen([str(repo/'.venv/bin/python'),'-c',code],cwd=repo,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,text=True,start_new_session=True)
try:o,e=p.communicate(timeout=80)
except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:os.killpg(p.pid,signal.SIGKILL);raise SystemExit('TIMEOUT')
print('EXIT',p.returncode,'OUTPUT',o[-4200:],'ERROR',e[-800:],flush=True)
if p.returncode:raise SystemExit('INTEGRATION_VALIDATION_FAILED')
r=json.loads(o)
assert r['http_status']==200 and r['synthetic_verified_matches']>=1
assert r['wrong_employer_matches']==0 and r['matched_remain_review']
assert r['auth']=='not_attempted' and r['fill']=='not_attempted' and r['submit']=='not_attempted'
assert git('rev-parse','HEAD')==base
print('LIVE_READONLY_SCOPED_ANSWER_INTEGRATION_VERIFIED',flush=True)
